description: This file contains unit tests for the SugarModule class within the SuiteCRM project. It verifies constructor behavior, module implementation checks, and bean loading functionality, using PHPUnit framework and reflection for private property inspection.

classes.name: SugarModuleTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the SugarModule class functionalities within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testconstructor
methods.description: Tests the constructor behavior of SugarModule with valid and invalid inputs, checking private property '_moduleName'.

methods.name: testmoduleImplements
methods.description: Verifies the moduleImplements method for different module types and names.

methods.name: testloadBean
methods.description: Checks if loadBean returns an instance of 'User' for a valid module and false for an invalid one.
